subject: Limit on number of observations in mice?

messages.author: 891f30de712ebf89
messages.subject: Limit on number of observations in mice?
parts: Hi! I'm using mice on a large dataset (~48K observations on a couple of dozen variables) in order to do a factor analysis using cfa(). However, when I run mice, the resulting data vectors have length 944 even though the original variables have many thousands of observations. Is there an upper limit on the number of observations you can use in the mice package? Or am I running into some other issue?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Limit on number of observations in mice?
parts:
I'm not sure.  Are you using the mice() function, or are you using semTools::runMI (or cfa.mi) to run mice?  If the latter, it might help to try running mice() and see if the same problem occurs.

Terry

messages.author: deec6d9174880bed
messages.subject: Re: Limit on number of observations in mice?
parts:
Thanks! For reasons I don't understand it went away when I used a smaller subset of the variables so it's all working great now.

Best,
Holt
